reviews.reason: Requires server-sent-event fragment rendering. JobPulse exposes JSON REST endpoints and no SSE or fragment rendering. No fixed 6.2.x release was available at review. Reassess before introducing streaming views.

Requires XsltView with implicit view names from a wildcard controller mapping. JobPulse uses RestController JSON endpoints, no XSLT views or templates, and no wildcard view-rendering controller. No fixed 6.2.x release was available at review.
